items.str: A Note on Reading Long Texts
Grace Hopper
Attention mechanisms (Bahdanau et al., 2015) changed how models read. The transformer
(Vaswani et al., 2017) removed recurrence entirely, and pretrained encoders such as BERT (Devlin
et al., 2019) made it standard. Long documents pose a challenge for attention models because
memory grows quadratically with the sequence length. We study sparse patterns that keep a local
window and a few global tokens, and we measure how retrieval quality changes as the context
grows. The method is simple to implement and works with existing pretrained checkpoints. Long
